en_title: PUBG is Getting a Live-Action Series on Netflix Written, Directed by, and Starring Donald Glover
cn_title: 格洛弗自编自导自演《绝地求生》剧集
subtitle: 百人战场搬上荧屏
opus_summary: 唐纳德·格洛弗将担任Netflix《绝地求生》真人剧的编剧、制片人、导演及主演。他的兄弟Stephen Glover也将参与编剧，并担任执行制片人。

paragraphs.en: Yep, you read that right: Grammy-award winning music artist and actor Donald Glover is directing and starring in a live-action series adapting Krafton’s battle royale game, PUBG.
paragraphs.cn: 没错，你没看错：格莱美奖得主、音乐人兼演员唐纳德·格洛弗将执导并主演一部真人剧集，改编自Krafton旗下的大逃杀游戏《绝地求生》。

paragraphs.en: PlayerUnknown's Battlegrounds is getting the Hollywood treatment with a TV show that will be written, produced, directed by, and starring Donald Glover. His brother, Stephen Glover, is also involved in the project as a co-writer and executive producer.
paragraphs.cn: 《绝地求生》即将被好莱坞改编为电视剧，唐纳德·格洛弗将担任编剧、制片人、导演并主演。他的兄弟Stephen Glover也将参与该项目，担任联合编剧和执行制片人。

paragraphs.en: Other executive producers on the series include Michael Schaefer for NEON TV, Fam Udeorji for Gilga, and Taeseok Jang and Sujin Lee for LV3H. As told in a press release shared with IGN, Krafton — the South Korean gaming conglomerate that owns the franchise — is intent on expanding the IP into “original entertainment content.” LV3H, its entertainment entity, is also helping develop and produce the series.
paragraphs.cn: 该剧的其他执行制片人包括代表NEON TV的Michael Schaefer、代表Gilga的Fam Udeorji，以及代表LV3H的Taeseok Jang和Sujin Lee。据一份提供给IGN的新闻稿介绍，拥有该系列的韩国游戏集团Krafton有意将这一IP拓展为「原创娱乐内容」。旗下娱乐公司LV3H也将协助开发和制作这部剧集。

paragraphs.en: While making an entire series based on a game where 100 players are dropped onto an island to fight to the death might seem like a bit of a stretch, there’s actually some pretty deep lore that explains the ‘why’ of it all. Admittedly, PUBG was initially created as a purely multiplayer experience, but it has since been fleshed out with an encompassing narrative that can be read on its official website.
paragraphs.cn: 这款游戏的内容是让100名玩家空降到一座岛上，展开殊死搏斗。要以此拍成一整部剧集，似乎有些勉强，但游戏其实有相当深入的背景设定，解释了这一切为何发生。诚然，《绝地求生》最初只是纯粹的多人游戏，但此后已逐步补充出完整的故事，玩家可以在官网上阅读。

paragraphs.en: The long and short of it is that the Battlegrounds are the brainchild of a billionaire named Sergei Kalimnik, who was the lone survivor of a deadly Soviet attack on the fictional island of Erangel in 1965. After experiencing “17 days of conflict” and watching Soviet officials attempt to dispose of their victims’ corpses, he came up with the brilliant idea of eventually buying the island and recreating his childhood trauma on a grand scale — conscripting 100 people and forcing them to fight until only one remains.
paragraphs.cn: 简单来说，这些战场出自亿万富翁Sergei Kalimnik的构想。1965年，苏联对虚构的艾伦格岛发动了一场致命袭击，他是唯一的幸存者。在经历了「17天的冲突」，并目睹苏联官员试图处理遇害者的尸体后，他想出了这么个绝妙主意：日后买下这座岛，大规模重现自己的童年创伤——强征100人，逼迫他们相互厮杀，直到只剩一人。

paragraphs.en: It’s sort of like Squid Game , when you think about it; these experiments expanded to other locales, while audience of shadowy, untouchable elites, much like the VIPs from Netflix’s hit South Korean thriller series, watch from afar. According to the PUBG Universe page, this also somehow ties back to a centuries-old tradition called ‘Magna Venari: The Great Hunt’ that began in the early 15th Century. Described as the “hunting of human prey,” it sought to answer a single question: “Why do some survive when others do not?”
paragraphs.cn: 仔细想想，这有点像《鱿鱼游戏》：这些实验扩展到了其他地点，一群神秘、无人敢动的精英观众则在远处观看，很像Netflix这部热门韩国惊悚剧中的VIP。根据《绝地求生》宇宙页面的介绍，这一切还不知怎么与一项始于15世纪初、延续数百年的传统有关，名为「Magna Venari：大狩猎」。这项传统被描述为「猎杀人类猎物」，试图回答一个问题：「为什么有些人能幸存，另一些人却不能？」

paragraphs.en: There’s, surprisingly, a lot for Glover to work with here. And given his talents in showbiz ( Atlanta , Community, Swarm), I’m genuinely keen to see what he brings to the table from the PUBG world.
paragraphs.cn: 令人意外的是，这里有不少可供格洛弗发挥的素材。考虑到他在《亚特兰大》《废柴联盟》和《蜂群》等影视作品中展现的才华，我确实很期待看看他能用《绝地求生》的世界打造出怎样的作品。

paragraphs.en: This is the latest video game to score a celebrity-led adaptation following news of Michael B. Jordan’s Battlefield movie . He, alongside Christopher McQuarrie, are reportedly shopping the adaptation around to different studios in hopes of bringing Electronic Arts’ popular military game series to the silver screen. Sony has emerged as a frontrunner to snag the film, though any other news remains nebulous for now.
paragraphs.cn: 继迈克尔·B·乔丹将参与《战地》电影的消息传出后，《绝地求生》成为又一部由明星领衔改编的游戏。据报道，乔丹正与克里斯托弗·麦奎里一起向不同电影公司推介这部改编作品，希望将EA旗下的人气军事游戏系列搬上大银幕。目前，索尼最有希望拿下这部电影，但其他消息暂时仍不明朗。
